federation.note: The ONE audited generic runtime for the federation-codegen pipeline (design rev-3 P0). Interprets a fail-closed-validated JSON shape-manifest to parse / validate / read / write RDF over @rdfjs/wrapper, carrying the full guard inventory the six hand-written @jeswr data-model packages duplicated (http(s)-only lexical IRI filtering, tryRead fail-closed field drops, singleton/default semantics, control-char sanitization on text writes, size/depth caps). Phase-M adds the COMPOSITE (document-projection) entity kind — a root + named sub-nodes projected as ONE flat object across several connected RDF nodes of one document (a `nested` link field binds a node predicate to a sub-node), with fail-closed cross-node MUSTs (a Violation-graded nested link whose target sub-node does not conform rejects the whole composite) — the shape the hand-written multi-node models (@jeswr/solid-listening's ScrobbleData) carry. Generated model.js/model.json/model.d.ts artifacts carry NO executable logic — all behaviour lives here, audited once. securityCritical: the shared interpreter of federation-sourced schemas for every domain. GitHub-installable now (committed dist/, ignore-scripts=true); npm publish is a deferred migration.
